cases.why: an empty queue has nowhere to go
an empty queue stays empty even with repeat all
no current row starts at the first row
the queue ends rather than wrapping
repeat one restarts the current row
repeat one at the tail does not wrap
repeat one with no current row still starts at the first
a single row ends, it does not replay
repeat all keeps a one-row queue alive
repeat one on a single row is the same row
an unknown repeat mode falls back to off
a non-integer cursor means nothing is playing
a negative length is an empty queue
length is clamped to MAX_ITEMS, so the last row is 49999
